dz: 来自印度的法特尔·拉扎克号在特立尼达和多巴哥的帕里亚湾登陆,载着第一批印度人到该国.
de: The Fatel Razack, coming from India, lands in the Gulf of Paria in Trinidad and Tobago carrying the first Indians to the country.

t: 约翰·弗朗西斯在维多利亚女王与阿尔伯特亲王驾车驶下伦敦宪法山时试图谋杀她。
te: John Francis attempts to murder Queen Victoria as she drives down Constitution Hill in London with Prince Albert.
dz: 约翰·弗朗西斯在维多利亚女王与阿尔伯特亲王驾车驶下伦敦宪法山时试图谋杀她。
de: John Francis attempts to murder Queen Victoria as she drives down Constitution Hill in London with Prince Albert.

t: 司法部长若阿金·安东尼奥·德·阿吉亚尔(Joaquim António de Aguiar)颁…
te: Minister of Justice Joaquim António de Aguiar issues a law seizing "all convents, monasteries, colleges, hospices and a…
dz: 司法部长若阿金·安东尼奥·德·阿吉亚尔(Joaquim António de Aguiar)颁布一项法律,从葡萄牙的天主教宗教命令中夺取"所有修道院,修道院,学院,修道院和任何其他房屋",为他赢得了"修道院-基勒"的外号.
de: Minister of Justice Joaquim António de Aguiar issues a law seizing "all convents, monasteries, colleges, hospices and any other houses" from the Catholic religious orders in Portugal, earning him the nickname of "The Friar-Killer".

t: 东印度人阿尼斯顿号在今南非阿古尔哈斯角附近的温克斯克兰斯(英语:Waenhuiskrans)的…
te: The East Indiaman Arniston is wrecked during a storm at Waenhuiskrans, near Cape Agulhas, in present-day South Africa, …
dz: 东印度人阿尼斯顿号在今南非阿古尔哈斯角附近的温克斯克兰斯(英语:Waenhuiskrans)的风暴中被撞倒,共有372人丧生.
de: The East Indiaman Arniston is wrecked during a storm at Waenhuiskrans, near Cape Agulhas, in present-day South Africa, with the loss of 372 lives.

t: "巴黎第一条约"已经签署,将法国的边界恢复到1792年的程度,并恢复了波旁王室的统治.
te: The First Treaty of Paris is signed, returning the French frontiers to their 1792 extent, and restoring the House of Bo…
dz: "巴黎第一条约"已经签署,将法国的边界恢复到1792年的程度,并恢复了波旁王室的统治.
de: The First Treaty of Paris is signed, returning the French frontiers to their 1792 extent, and restoring the House of Bourbon to power.

t: 未来美国总统安德鲁·杰克逊在决斗中杀死了查尔斯·迪金森.
te: Future U.S. President Andrew Jackson kills Charles Dickinson in a duel.
dz: 未来美国总统安德鲁·杰克逊在决斗中杀死了查尔斯·迪金森.
de: Future U.S. President Andrew Jackson kills Charles Dickinson in a duel.

t: 在博尔盖托战役中，拿破仑·波拿巴成功渡过明乔河对抗奥地利军队。这次渡河迫使奥地利人放弃伦巴第并…
te: In the Battle of Borghetto, Napoleon Bonaparte manages to cross the Mincio River against the Austrian army. This crossi…
dz: 第一次反法同盟战争：在博尔盖托战役中，拿破仑·波拿巴成功渡过明乔河对抗奥地利军队。这次渡河迫使奥地利人放弃伦巴第并撤退到蒂罗尔河，曼图亚要塞成为意大利北部唯一的奥地利据点。
de: War of the First Coalition: In the Battle of Borghetto, Napoleon Bonaparte manages to cross the Mincio River against the Austrian army. This crossing forces the Austrians to abandon Lombardy and retreat to the Tyrol, leaving the fortress of Mantua as the sole remaining Austrian stronghold in Northern Italy.

t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫出任莱比锡圣托马斯教堂乐长（Thomaskantor），并于三一节后的第…
te: Johann Sebastian Bach assumes the office of Thomaskantor in Leipzig, presenting his first new cantata, Die Elenden soll…
dz: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫出任莱比锡圣托马斯教堂乐长（Thomaskantor），并于三一节后的第一个星期日在圣尼古拉教堂演出其首部新康塔塔《Die Elenden sollen essen》（BWV 75）。
de: Johann Sebastian Bach assumes the office of Thomaskantor in Leipzig, presenting his first new cantata, Die Elenden sollen essen, BWV 75, in the St. Nicholas Church on the first Sunday after Trinity.

t: 从这一天起,英格兰查理一世授予的所有荣誉都被议会追溯废除.
te: From this date all honors granted by Charles I of England are retroactively annulled by Parliament.
dz: 从这一天起,英格兰查理一世授予的所有荣誉都被议会追溯废除.
de: From this date all honors granted by Charles I of England are retroactively annulled by Parliament.

t: 三十年战争：布拉格和约签署。
te: The Peace of Prague is signed.
dz: 三十年战争：布拉格和约签署。
de: Thirty Years' War: The Peace of Prague is signed.

t: 法国第一家报纸《法国公报》的出版.
te: Publication of Gazette de France, the first French newspaper.
dz: 法国第一家报纸《法国公报》的出版.
de: Publication of Gazette de France, the first French newspaper.

t: 西班牙阿玛达号的最后一艘舰从里斯本起航,驶向英吉利海峡.
te: The last ship of the Spanish Armada sets sail from Lisbon heading for the English Channel.
dz: 西班牙阿玛达号的最后一艘舰从里斯本起航,驶向英吉利海峡.
de: The last ship of the Spanish Armada sets sail from Lisbon heading for the English Channel.

t: 亨利三世成为了法国国王.
te: Henry III becomes King of France.
dz: 亨利三世成为了法国国王.
de: Henry III becomes King of France.

te: In Florida, Hernando de Soto lands at Tampa Bay with 600 soldiers with the goal of finding gold.
dz: 在佛罗里达州，埃尔南多·德索托 (Hernando de Soto) 带着 600 名士兵登陆坦帕湾，目标是寻找黄金。
de: In Florida, Hernando de Soto lands at Tampa Bay with 600 soldiers with the goal of finding gold.

t: 英国国王亨利八世与他前两位妻子的侍女简·西摩结婚。
te: King Henry VIII of England marries Jane Seymour, a lady-in-waiting to his first two wives.
dz: 英国国王亨利八世与他前两位妻子的侍女简·西摩结婚。
de: King Henry VIII of England marries Jane Seymour, a lady-in-waiting to his first two wives.

te: During the reign of the Zhengde Emperor, Ming dynasty rebel leader Zhu Zhifan is defeated by commander Qiu Yue, ending …
dz: 在正德皇帝统治时期,明朝造反派首领朱子范被都指挥使邱岳所败,结束了安华叛乱太子.
de: During the reign of the Zhengde Emperor, Ming dynasty rebel leader Zhu Zhifan is defeated by commander Qiu Yue, ending the Prince of Anhua rebellion.

t: 利帕尼战役:战争结束 乌特拉奎斯特战败并消灭了塔博里特势力.
te: Battle of Lipany: End of the war, the Utraquist defeat and annihilate Taborite forces.
dz: 胡塞斯战争:利帕尼战役:战争结束 乌特拉奎斯特战败并消灭了塔博里特势力.
de: Hussite Wars: Battle of Lipany: End of the war, the Utraquist defeat and annihilate Taborite forces.

t: 在法国鲁昂，19 岁的圣女贞德被英国主导的法庭烧死在火刑柱上。
te: In Rouen, France, the 19-year-old Joan of Arc is burned at the stake by an English-dominated tribunal.
dz: 百年战争：在法国鲁昂，19 岁的圣女贞德被英国主导的法庭烧死在火刑柱上。
de: Hundred Years' War: In Rouen, France, the 19-year-old Joan of Arc is burned at the stake by an English-dominated tribunal.

t: 康斯坦斯议会由安提波佩·约翰二十三世的支持者西吉斯蒙德皇帝召集,在对异端进行审判后烧毁了布拉格…
te: The Council of Constance, called by Emperor Sigismund, a supporter of Antipope John XXIII, burns Jerome of Prague follo…
dz: 康斯坦斯议会由安提波佩·约翰二十三世的支持者西吉斯蒙德皇帝召集,在对异端进行审判后烧毁了布拉格的杰罗姆.
de: The Council of Constance, called by Emperor Sigismund, a supporter of Antipope John XXIII, burns Jerome of Prague following a trial for heresy.

te: Beginning of the Peasants' Revolt in England.
dz: 英格兰农民革命的开始.
de: Beginning of the Peasants' Revolt in England.
